name: webuild
description: Discover, plan and rate the best of Bangalore.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @webuild/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @webuild/shared && npm run build -w @webuild/api && npm run build -w @webuild/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @webuild/shared && npm run typecheck -w @webuild/shared && npm run typecheck -w @webuild/api && npm run typecheck -w @webuild/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @webuild/shared && npm run test -w @webuild/api
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
